source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1009's RepoClient opens Mercurial only when root/.hg exists. Otherwise it asks git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree and turns either a failed command or a non-true response into Unsupported repository. This permits Git layouts where .git is a file or the root is inside a worktree. This inspected Thunderbird fork is dependency integration evidence, not a source of global Thunderbird Python style.
title: Detect a localization Git worktree by its Git authority, not a .git directory
